One blow — and the fight is over.
Ожившая кладка. Медленный и тяжёлый, обр: Living masonry. Slow and heavy, it brings down a blow over an area.
Оживший страж руин. Броня как скала, уда: An awakened guardian of the ruins. Armor like a cliff, a blow like a rockslide.
Оно было солнцем. Оно устало светить для: It was the sun. It grew tired of shining for those who never looked up, and fell down so that it would finally be seen. It called servants and wrung them to ash — the gravedigger it raised twice. You have passed through them all. Now look it in the eye and decide whether there is enough light in you.
Осколок чужого отражения. Проходит сквоз: A shard of someone else's reflection. Passes through walls and cuts with light.
A sharp bone spear pierces enemies.
A sharp trophy. Alchemists pay for these.
Открывает стартовые предметы: карту этаж: Unlocks starting items: a floor map and bombs.
Отлит из языка колокола Храма Солнца. Бр: Cast from the clapper of the Sun Temple's bell. Brother Ostwin rang it until the water closed over his head.
Отражение Иллюзиониста. Исчезает от перв: A reflection of the Illusionist. Vanishes at the first blow and leaves nothing behind — but its hits are real.
Smells of smoke and doesn't burn.
Smells so strong that monsters turn around.
Пепельный король — Олдрик, павший дважды: The Ash King — Oldric, Twice Fallen
Переносит в случайное безопасное место э: Carries you to a random safe spot on the floor.
The flanges of the mace crush any plate.
Печать держится, но город пустеет: кто м: The seal holds, but the city is emptying: whoever could went up to the surface, to the edge of the gorge, where they founded the village by the entrance. The temple collapsed inward, into the chasm. I stay with the scrolls. Someone has to remember that beneath the ruins there are no stones — there is an oath.

Пищащая тень под сводами. Слабая, но нал: A squeaking shadow under the vaults. Weak, but swoops in flocks and strikes from above.
Пламя Затмения во плоти. Огненные шары,: The Eclipse's flame made flesh. Fireballs, rings of fire and burning ground.
Пламя, которое не гаснет: The Flame That Won't Go Out
Плюётся липкой грязью: попавший в неё ел: Spits sticky mud: whoever it hits can barely move their feet.
Повелеваю: сжечь катакомбы и всё, что в: I command: burn the catacombs and everything that walks in them. The gravedigger who called himself the Bone King is dead — his throne lies scattered — but his bones do not rest. Let fire do what the sword did not. Leave not a single bone to the dark.
Повелитель мёртвых: поднимает скелетов,: Master of the dead: raises skeletons, sends plague and hides behind bone armor. Damage depends on Intelligence. Shadow Step (RMB / L): a short dash through the dark during which you can't be hurt.

The dungeon as it was meant to be.
Подземные воды поднялись. Своды затопило: The underground waters rose. The vaults flooded knee-deep, then waist-deep. The brothers left. I tied myself to the bell. The water is cold, but the toll carries farther underwater — even the stones feel it. Let it hear. Let it not sleep.
Let you push off the very air.

Stronger hex: poison and magic hurt more.
